contentText: In tonight's edition,  concerns are mounting that electoral violence could deter voters from taking part in Nigeria’s presidential election in January. Also, the driver of a car suspected of causing a fuel tanker to overturn on a major highway in Egypt is detained. And Sierra Leone was once considered the most dangerous place in the world to give birth. Today, maternal deaths have dropped dramatically.
